meta.title: Astronomia: hadahan and porondam
meta.description: Your birth chart and marriage matching, worked out precisely and explained in Sinhala or English.

hero.title: Your birth chart, read with clarity.
hero.lead: Astronomia works out your hadahan and porondam from precise planetary positions. Then it explains every result in plain Sinhala or English, for a birth anywhere in the world.
hero.privacy: No sign up. Nothing you enter is stored.
hero.wheelLabel: A slowly turning zodiac wheel with the twelve rashi named in Sinhala and planets in orbit

tools.title: Two tools, done properly
tools.lead: Start with either one. Both show how the result was reached.

hadahan.label: හඳහන
hadahan.title: Hadahan, your birth chart
items: Lagna, rashi and nakath at a glance
Nine planets, navamsha and the kendara drawing
A dasha timeline of your life periods

porondam.label: පොරොන්දම්
porondam.title: Porondam, marriage matching
items: Every factor shown one by one, with the reason
Rajju and Vedha kept apart from the score
Kuja dosha checked for both people

rashi.title: The twelve rashi
rashi.lead: Your lagna and your Moon sign each fall in one of these.

steps.title: Enter the birth details
steps.text: Date, time and place. Search any town in the world, or type the coordinates yourself.

steps.title: We calculate the sky
steps.text: Planet positions come from astronomical data. Time zones follow the real history of each country.

steps.title: Read a clear result
steps.text: A visual chart with plain reasons beside each point. Switch between Sinhala and English at any time.

trust.title: The method is shown
trust.text: Each result names the ayanamsa and the rule set used.

trust.title: Private by default
trust.text: Birth details are used for the calculation and then discarded.

trust.title: Made for the world
trust.text: Born in Colombo, London or Melbourne, the chart is worked out the same careful way.

footer.disclaimer: For guidance and cultural interest. For important decisions, speak with your family and a practising astrologer.
